list.name: size_class
list.label: Size class
list.query: Single (1) : single, Small (2-20) : small, Medium (21-100) : medium, Large (101-1000) : large, Huge (>1000) : huge

list.name: group
list.label: Group
list.query:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, group_id, count(*) AS instruments
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_standardized_instrument_groups/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT group_id::VARCHAR AS group_id
FROM d
GROUP BY group_id
HAVING CASE
    WHEN max(instruments) = 1 THEN 'single'
    WHEN max(instruments) <= 20 THEN 'small'
    WHEN max(instruments) <= 100 THEN 'medium'
    WHEN max(instruments) <= 1000 THEN 'large'
    ELSE 'huge'
  END IN ($size_class)
ORDER BY avg(instruments) DESC, group_id
LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Instruments (latest day)
panels.description: Instruments in the selected groups on the latest day in the range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, group_id, count(*) AS instruments
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_standardized_instrument_groups/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE group_id::VARCHAR IN ($group)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY ALL
),
s AS (
  SELECT group_id, CASE
      WHEN max(instruments) = 1 THEN 'single'
      WHEN max(instruments) <= 20 THEN 'small'
      WHEN max(instruments) <= 100 THEN 'medium'
      WHEN max(instruments) <= 1000 THEN 'large'
      ELSE 'huge'
    END AS size_class
  FROM d
  GROUP BY group_id
)
SELECT sum(instruments)::BIGINT AS instruments
FROM d
JOIN s USING (group_id)
WHERE s.size_class IN ($size_class)
  AND d.trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)

panels.title: Net change vs start of range
panels.description: Instruments in the selected groups on the latest day minus the first day in the range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, group_id, count(*) AS instruments
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_standardized_instrument_groups/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE group_id::VARCHAR IN ($group)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY ALL
),
s AS (
  SELECT group_id, CASE
      WHEN max(instruments) = 1 THEN 'single'
      WHEN max(instruments) <= 20 THEN 'small'
      WHEN max(instruments) <= 100 THEN 'medium'
      WHEN max(instruments) <= 1000 THEN 'large'
      ELSE 'huge'
    END AS size_class
  FROM d
  GROUP BY group_id
)
, b AS (
  SELECT min(trad_dt) AS first_day, max(trad_dt) AS last_day FROM d
)
SELECT (coalesce(sum(instruments) FILTER (WHERE trad_dt = last_day), 0)
  - coalesce(sum(instruments) FILTER (WHERE trad_dt = first_day), 0))::BIGINT AS change
FROM d
JOIN s USING (group_id)
CROSS JOIN b
WHERE s.size_class IN ($size_class)

panels.title: Additions (range)
panels.description: Instruments that joined a selected group vs the previous trading day, summed over the range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, group_id, instrument_id
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_standardized_instrument_groups/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE group_id::VARCHAR IN ($group)
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
sz AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, group_id, count(*) AS instruments
  FROM m
  GROUP BY ALL
),
s AS (
  SELECT group_id, CASE
      WHEN max(instruments) = 1 THEN 'single'
      WHEN max(instruments) <= 20 THEN 'small'
      WHEN max(instruments) <= 100 THEN 'medium'
      WHEN max(instruments) <= 1000 THEN 'large'
      ELSE 'huge'
    END AS size_class
  FROM sz
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY group_id
),
days AS (
  SELECT trad_dt,
    lag(trad_dt) OVER (ORDER BY trad_dt) AS prev_dt,
    lead(trad_dt) OVER (ORDER BY trad_dt) AS next_dt
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT trad_dt
    FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_standardized_instrument_groups/daily_parse/*.parquet')
    WHERE trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
      AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
  )
),
x AS (
  SELECT m.trad_dt, m.group_id, days.prev_dt, days.next_dt,
    lag(m.trad_dt) OVER w AS prev_seen,
    lead(m.trad_dt) OVER w AS next_seen
  FROM m
  JOIN days ON days.trad_dt = m.trad_dt
  JOIN s ON s.group_id = m.group_id
  WHERE s.size_class IN ($size_class)
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY m.group_id, m.instrument_id ORDER BY m.trad_dt)
),
ev AS (
  SELECT trad_dt AS day, group_id, 1 AS added, 0 AS removed
  FROM x
  WHERE prev_dt IS NOT NULL AND prev_seen IS DISTINCT FROM prev_dt
  UNION ALL
  SELECT next_dt AS day, group_id, 0 AS added, 1 AS removed
  FROM x
  WHERE next_dt IS NOT NULL AND next_seen IS DISTINCT FROM next_dt
),
grid AS (
  SELECT days.trad_dt AS day, g.group_id
  FROM days
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT group_id FROM x) g
  WHERE days.prev_dt IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(days.trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
daily AS (
  SELECT grid.day, grid.group_id,
    coalesce(sum(ev.added), 0) AS added,
    coalesce(sum(ev.removed), 0) AS removed,
    coalesce(any_value(sz.instruments), 0) AS instruments
  FROM grid
  LEFT JOIN ev ON ev.day = grid.day AND ev.group_id = grid.group_id
  LEFT JOIN sz ON sz.trad_dt = grid.day AND sz.group_id = grid.group_id
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT sum(added)::BIGINT AS additions
FROM daily

panels.title: Selected groups (latest day in range)
panels.description: Size, change and presence of the selected groups over the range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, group_id, count(*) AS instruments
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_standardized_instrument_groups/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE group_id::VARCHAR IN ($group)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY ALL
),
s AS (
  SELECT group_id, CASE
      WHEN max(instruments) = 1 THEN 'single'
      WHEN max(instruments) <= 20 THEN 'small'
      WHEN max(instruments) <= 100 THEN 'medium'
      WHEN max(instruments) <= 1000 THEN 'large'
      ELSE 'huge'
    END AS size_class
  FROM d
  GROUP BY group_id
)
, b AS (
  SELECT min(trad_dt) AS first_day, max(trad_dt) AS last_day FROM d
),
r AS (
  SELECT group_id,
    coalesce(max(instruments) FILTER (WHERE trad_dt = last_day), 0) AS instruments,
    coalesce(max(instruments) FILTER (WHERE trad_dt = first_day), 0) AS instruments_at_start,
    max(instruments) AS peak,
    min(instruments) AS trough,
    avg(instruments) AS avg_instruments,
    count(*) AS days_present,
    min(trad_dt) AS first_seen,
    max(trad_dt) AS last_seen
  FROM d
  CROSS JOIN b
  GROUP BY group_id
)
SELECT group_id::VARCHAR AS group_id,
  s.size_class,
  instruments::BIGINT AS instruments,
  instruments_at_start::BIGINT AS instruments_at_start,
  (instruments - instruments_at_start)::BIGINT AS change,
  ((instruments - instruments_at_start) / nullif(instruments_at_start, 0))::DOUBLE AS change_pct,
  peak::BIGINT AS peak,
  trough::BIGINT AS trough,
  round(avg_instruments, 1)::DOUBLE AS avg_instruments,
  days_present::BIGINT AS days_present,
  strftime(first_seen, '%Y-%m-%d') AS first_seen,
  strftime(last_seen, '%Y-%m-%d') AS last_seen
FROM r
JOIN s USING (group_id)
WHERE s.size_class IN ($size_class)
ORDER BY instruments DESC, group_id

panels.title: Instruments added/removed in selected groups (within range)
panels.description: Instruments that joined or left the selected groups within the range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, group_id, instrument_id
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_standardized_instrument_groups/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE group_id::VARCHAR IN ($group)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
s AS (
  SELECT group_id, CASE
      WHEN max(instruments) = 1 THEN 'single'
      WHEN max(instruments) <= 20 THEN 'small'
      WHEN max(instruments) <= 100 THEN 'medium'
      WHEN max(instruments) <= 1000 THEN 'large'
      ELSE 'huge'
    END AS size_class
  FROM (SELECT trad_dt, group_id, count(*) AS instruments FROM m GROUP BY ALL)
  GROUP BY group_id
),
b AS (
  SELECT min(trad_dt) AS first_day, max(trad_dt) AS last_day FROM m
),
e AS (
  SELECT instrument_id, group_id,
    min(trad_dt) AS first_seen,
    max(trad_dt) AS last_seen,
    count(*) AS sessions,
    any_value(first_day) AS first_day,
    any_value(last_day) AS last_day
  FROM m
  CROSS JOIN b
  GROUP BY instrument_id, group_id
)
SELECT instrument_id::VARCHAR AS instrument_id,
  group_id::VARCHAR AS group_id,
  s.size_class,
  CASE WHEN last_seen < last_day THEN 'removed' ELSE 'added' END AS status,
  strftime(first_seen, '%Y-%m-%d') AS first_seen,
  strftime(last_seen, '%Y-%m-%d') AS last_seen,
  sessions::BIGINT AS sessions
FROM e
JOIN s USING (group_id)
WHERE s.size_class IN ($size_class)
  AND (first_seen > first_day OR last_seen < last_day)
ORDER BY CASE WHEN last_seen < last_day THEN last_seen ELSE first_seen END DESC, group_id, instrument_id
LIMIT 2000

panels.title: Group $group membership
panels.description: Daily size (left axis) with instruments added and removed (right axis), one panel per selected group.

targets.rawSql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, group_id, instrument_id
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_standardized_instrument_groups/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE group_id::VARCHAR = $group
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
sz AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, group_id, count(*) AS instruments
  FROM m
  GROUP BY ALL
),
s AS (
  SELECT group_id, CASE
      WHEN max(instruments) = 1 THEN 'single'
      WHEN max(instruments) <= 20 THEN 'small'
      WHEN max(instruments) <= 100 THEN 'medium'
      WHEN max(instruments) <= 1000 THEN 'large'
      ELSE 'huge'
    END AS size_class
  FROM sz
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY group_id
),
days AS (
  SELECT trad_dt,
    lag(trad_dt) OVER (ORDER BY trad_dt) AS prev_dt,
    lead(trad_dt) OVER (ORDER BY trad_dt) AS next_dt
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT trad_dt
    FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_standardized_instrument_groups/daily_parse/*.parquet')
    WHERE trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
      AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
  )
),
x AS (
  SELECT m.trad_dt, m.group_id, days.prev_dt, days.next_dt,
    lag(m.trad_dt) OVER w AS prev_seen,
    lead(m.trad_dt) OVER w AS next_seen
  FROM m
  JOIN days ON days.trad_dt = m.trad_dt
  JOIN s ON s.group_id = m.group_id
  WHERE s.size_class IN ($size_class)
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY m.group_id, m.instrument_id ORDER BY m.trad_dt)
),
ev AS (
  SELECT trad_dt AS day, group_id, 1 AS added, 0 AS removed
  FROM x
  WHERE prev_dt IS NOT NULL AND prev_seen IS DISTINCT FROM prev_dt
  UNION ALL
  SELECT next_dt AS day, group_id, 0 AS added, 1 AS removed
  FROM x
  WHERE next_dt IS NOT NULL AND next_seen IS DISTINCT FROM next_dt
),
grid AS (
  SELECT days.trad_dt AS day, g.group_id
  FROM days
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT group_id FROM x) g
  WHERE days.prev_dt IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(days.trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
daily AS (
  SELECT grid.day, grid.group_id,
    coalesce(sum(ev.added), 0) AS added,
    coalesce(sum(ev.removed), 0) AS removed,
    coalesce(any_value(sz.instruments), 0) AS instruments
  FROM grid
  LEFT JOIN ev ON ev.day = grid.day AND ev.group_id = grid.group_id
  LEFT JOIN sz ON sz.trad_dt = grid.day AND sz.group_id = grid.group_id
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT day::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  instruments::BIGINT AS "Instruments",
  added::BIGINT AS "Added",
  (-removed)::BIGINT AS "Removed"
FROM daily
ORDER BY time
